brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build has one piece only at 0,0,0 level 0: piece:0,0,0;half-s. No neighboring bases and no stacked level. Original full base replaced with half-s to enable drawer; still a single base cell as configurator requires for any drawer.

Configurator allows at most one drawer per cell, filling the opposite half of a half-base (addDrawer key n on half-s). Attempt to add additional drawers returned HOST_MISMATCH and ALREADY_FITTED; no sockets offered for drawer after one installed. Full base offers zero drawer sockets. Double-height drawer also refused HOST_MISMATCH requiring stacked half bases, which would violate 'nothing on top'. Current build has 1 drawer (drawer:0#0,0#cut). Five drawers cannot be placed in a single cell under configurator rules.

finish.summary: Build is a single half-s base with its one possible drawer. Five drawers in one cell is blocked by configurator: a half-base holds exactly one drawer, a full base holds none, and stacking for double-height would violate the 'nothing on top/beside' constraint.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
